The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 所以他们找到了很多植物对药：来做药

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 很多植物对药：很多能做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot mean “able to be made into medicine”; “能做药的” correctly modifies the plants. [rule: none]
Run 2: 很多植物对药：很多可以做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot modify “植物” in this way; “可以做药的” correctly describes plants that can be used as medicine. [rule: none]

output.reason: Both runs identify the incorrect use of “对药” after “植物” and replace it with an equivalent modifier meaning plants that can be used as medicine.
